'''Passenger launches''' were [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. They were used by the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] to shuttle passengers between the [[Rokak'k Baran]] and the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]].
